entries.what: identified CSS masks with system colours as the mechanism in comment #7; the original proof of concept this fix builds on
use a CSS mask for the toolbar icon and a system colour (CanvasText) to paint it

extended the mask approach to every Core toolbar icon with an explicit --ckeditor5-toolbar-icon opt-in, moved the Alignment mask to ::before so the caret survives, and added a forced-colors filter reset for the #3637246 dark-mode invert
produced the Before/After evidence: pixel measurement of all 35 rendered controls, keyboard/drag/save flows, WebKit and accessibility-tree checks, and the combined #3637246 compatibility measurement
masking the whole toolbar control clips the Alignment dropdown caret, and a background shorthand removes icons supplied by contributed plugins
with #3637246's dark-mode filter invert active the forced-colors mask becomes invisible (1:1) unless a forced-colors filter reset is added
variant B, masking the whole button element, was rejected: it clips descendants, turns un-opted contributed icons into solid boxes in normal mode, and makes the Alignment caret unusable
consolidated the implementation into MR !18007, chose CanvasText rather than ButtonText, and published it upstream (AI-assisted per the issue comment)

the MR-identical stack fails Drupal core stylelint with 35 errors in 18 files (declaration-empty-line-before, one Prettier selector list, one property-order), which is why the issue moved to Needs work
real Windows contrast themes and a human keyboard/screen-reader pass were not verified; the MR still needs the stylelint repair pushed and its unrelated failed CI jobs resolved
